name: video_playlist
title: Video Playlist
description: Video section of a project: a player (project_block_video -> block_video -> video, thumbnails and colors from data_items_video.json) with the title, year and a "More details" button, next to a scrolling playlist (number, thumbnail, title, year). Videos without a thumbnail get a box in the page color (light / dark) with the play icon. "More details" opens the video in the popup in the video_listing layout (one video: title, description, buttons). Default videos: every video of the project folder.
